doc: boundary_terrain_v1's input (design/boundary.md): the rim, the biome, the season, how far the world must reach, and how finely to build it.

fields.name: detail
fields.doc: How finely: the finest terrain spacing (2, 4, or 8 m), the images' size (64, 32, 16 texels a node), and how dense the rim's dressing is.

fields.name: view_distance
fields.doc: How far from the region the world reaches, metres.

fields.name: figure_range
fields.doc: How far beyond the rim trees and bushes are control figures for the game to fill, metres; past it the boundary draws its own (0: it draws them all).
